package: GitHub Release assets on the tag: one self-contained `ch` binary (CLI + MCP server) per platform, 7 platforms plus checksums.txt. Every binary is covered by verified GitHub build provenance and publication followed two independent byte-identical builds of the same commit. The stable release also publishes the ghcr image `:v0.6.0` and the signed apk repository channel; those channels and the SDK tarballs are outside this Distribution pin.

config.note: cork-defaults.v2.json (schema 2) is the versioned address surface of this component: per chain a SET of contract generations with one primary. Installs runtime-fetch it from the main branch (TTL-cached) as the living-field channel; the content at this tag is pinned here by digest. The schema-1 file cork-defaults.json is frozen for the 0.5 line and is not read by this version. This configuration binds the same Phoenix 1.4.0-rc.1, Market Registry 0.5.0 and Rollover 0.2.0 deployments this Distribution pins (factory 0x99A5C47CbF062D4E6665afAF32aE6496F9f93F65, ExactSettler 0x0F2Ce7a5b817865ebFf50c58439B9A27E38f452E, PartialSettler 0x5E19Be0743fE521d8BF85b5A558356675499bE9e on both chains); the previous Rollover factory and settlers stay configured as the phoenix/v0.3-rc.1 generation and are never the default target.

notices: Stable of the 0.6 line. The covered tool surface is byte-identical to 0.6.0-rc.1 (the tag differs from the candidate only in the version string, the changelog entry and test/evaluation files). The full mutation catalogue on the release tree reads 624 of 624 mutants caught; the offline suite is 1995 tests green; the Layer B agent evaluation is 84 of 84.
Review level is unreviewed and stage is partner-preview: no production support commitment attaches to this component version.

The primary generation on Arbitrum One and Base is phoenix/v0.4-rc.1: Phoenix 1.4.0-rc.1, Market Registry 0.5.0 (registry 0xe1f569f152bDB6eBB2d49cFd9d4aB98ECEe955c5, JIT adapter 0x3E01C558fc0854e92e6ef2a84c19D6Bf9D82B104, creator 0x1A074F17647504D1c50B436074a74d051D502dEa), Rollover 0.2.0 (factory 0x99A5C47CbF062D4E6665afAF32aE6496F9f93F65, ExactSettler 0x0F2Ce7a5b817865ebFf50c58439B9A27E38f452E, PartialSettler 0x5E19Be0743fE521d8BF85b5A558356675499bE9e), cork-periphery 0.2.0-rc.1 ForSelf adapter 0x3864902695DC930Df406ef5dEB74c4DC249e23f1. The same addresses on both chains.

The previous generation (phoenix/v0.3-rc.1: Phoenix v1.3.0-rc.1, Market Registry 0.3.3, Rollover v0.1.0-rc.2) and the older Arbitrum eras stay configured as active or read-only generations: pools on them are read, decoded and attributed by the pool's own generation; prepares against them need the `generation` input.

Migration between generations: the `generation` input accepts the aliases `previous` and `primary` beside a label, and `cork_query account-state` with `filters.account` and no `filters.poolId` lists the account's cST/cPT positions across every configured generation (pools enumerated from the chain over the caller's RPC by default, the venue's list under mode hybrid; balances always from the caller's RPC; each row carries the expiry as strict ISO-8601 UTC beside unix seconds). `cork_capabilities topic:"migration"` holds the recipe. Pool-scoped prepares and reads follow the pool's own generation from the chain.

Relative to the prior Distribution pin (0.4.1), the covered CLI/MCP surface is breaking: `additionalData` is `extraData` on every jitMarket input (the old name is accepted with a deprecation notice), `oracleSalt` and the two fee percentages join the JIT/derive inputs and the 10-field pool identity, `generation` is an optional input on every chain-backed tool, and the `cork_query orderbook` default order is ranked (0.5.1). The SDK surface changed accordingly (see the CHANGELOG).

Rollover artifacts against the 0.2.0 settlers commit the salted JITMarketParams (oracleSalt); rc.2 settlers keep the rc.2 commitment. Rollover remains excluded from this Distribution's covered API routes.
Venue listings accept only fraction-string `premiumAnnualized` (for example, `0.041` means 4.1%).
On SIGTERM or SIGINT, the MCP server drains in-flight requests for at most five seconds before exiting cleanly.

Embedded HyperSync requires writable, executable or mappable temporary storage. Windows x64 and Linux arm64-musl binaries have no embedded Envio binding and cannot provide full-decentralized HyperSync reads.

The Market Registry 0.5.0 holds registered assets on both chains since 2026-09-23 (14 on Base, 17 on Arbitrum; address-keyed denominations with USD conversion feeds). The nested JIT fill path was rehearsed against a fork of that live state on the release tree and passed: oracle deployed in-fill, 10-field pool created at the predicted id, cST at the predicted address.

Distribution channel: the pinned integration channel is the GitHub Release binaries above. SDK tarballs, the OCI image, the apk repository and the hosted CVM deployment are not part of this Distribution pin.
knownIssues: No CREATE2 attestation exists for the phoenix/v0.4-rc.1 set: the Distribution component records carry no salt, init code hash or deployer, so `cork_capabilities topic:"verify"` re-derives only the phoenix/v0.3-rc.1 and mainnet sets. Addresses of the new set are pinned by the Distribution records and by live code hashes.
